visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a night view of the Taipei 101 skyscraper. Golden fireworks explode outwards from various levels of the building. The word 'TAIWAN' is illuminated in bright red LED lights on the side of the tower. No people are visible. The setting is a dark urban sky with the brightly lit tower as the central object. (2) Green fireworks are introduced, mixing with the existing gold pyrotechnics. The skyscraper remains static in the frame as light patterns shift across its surface. Smoke begins to gather around the balconies. Lighting is dominated by the artificial bursts against the pitch-black background. (3) The display transitions to vibrant pink and purple fireworks that fan out in complex patterns. The 'TAIWAN' sign remains a steady red glow. The camera remains fixed, capturing the dense layers of sparks and smoke accumulating around the architectural landmark. (4) Intense white and silver fountain-style fireworks erupt vertically from the building's tiers. The sky is momentarily filled with brilliant white light, creating high-contrast cinematic lighting. The smoke density increases significantly, partially obscuring the upper portions of the tower's facade. (5) The pyrotechnics conclude, and the building's LED display shifts to a deep blue color. A graphic of a yellow trophy appears along with the text 'Team Taiwan Champion'. The residual smoke drifts slowly across the frame in the nighttime atmosphere, while the city lights are not visible below.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy pop-rock music begins featuring a melodic male vocal in Traditional Chinese. A series of percussive impact SFX (thuds and pops) occur, mirroring the launching of fireworks. The BGM has a strong drum beat and distorted electric guitar textures. (2) A sharp, loud 'bang' SFX triggers a new phase as the firework intensity increases. The vocal delivery becomes more energetic and strained, reaching for higher notes. The acoustic texture is dense with a mix of broadband noise from explosions and musical harmonics. (3) The music reaches a powerful chorus with soaring vocals and heavy percussion. Constant crackling and whistling SFX are layered over the mix. The ambient floor remains low, allowing the crisp production of the music and the sharp transients of the fireworks to dominate. (4) The track concludes with sustained synth pads and a final deep reverberating impact sound. The male singer holds a final long note before the audio fades. Minimal ambient hiss remains as the only audible element at the very end.

The inclusion of the 'Team Taiwan Champion' text suggests a celebration of a sports achievement, combined with high-arousal pop music to create a sense of national pride and excitement.
